text:
deploy-bot: Rollout complete for inference-api v2.3.1 -> prod-usw2. Starting post-deploy smoke checks (canary 10%). Runbook: https://go/runbooks/postdeploy. Kicking off synthetics and kvprobe suite.

sam: saw the deploy-bot alert. Any immediate failures?

jen: smoke panel shows kvprobe p95 jump on prod-usw2. p95 ~870ms vs baseline ~120ms :warning: (spike started ~+2m after rollout)

lee: digging into logs, seeing a burst of prefix cache misses leading to timeouts. snippet:
```
[smoke] kv-fetch timeout after 250ms
prefix_cache.go:213 cache miss -> fetching from store
store: read latency spike to 400ms
```

sam: do we have an automatic fallback for this pattern or do we need a manual rollback?

deploy-bot: Rollout policy: canary -> 100% scheduled. Automated rollback is disabled for kvprobe p95 regressions. Pinning or manual rollbacks require approval. React with :thumbsup: to approve immediate pin to previous version v2.3.0 for prod-usw2.

jen: i'd prefer not to full rollback yet. Proposal: pin routing in prod-usw2 to v2.3.0 (stop the 100% promotion) + run targeted synths with higher sampling and enable a larger prefill window for kv cache (30s). If metrics recover, unpin and continue; if not, rollback.

lee: +1. i'll prepare a hotpatch to increase prefill concurrency and add a tiny in-memory fallback for prefix hits (low-risk). Patch name: hp-908.

ria: creating INF-1234 and adding initial evidence and dashboards. tagging oncall.

oncall-bot: On-call incident created: INF-1234 assigned to lee. Priority: P2. Notify channel: #eng-oncall.

sam: clear action items: (1) pin prod-usw2 routing to v2.3.0 (jen) (2) deploy hp-908 to prod-usw2 (lee) (3) run 10min synthetic with sampling=200/s and report p95. do it now.

jen: pin complete. routing table shows prod-usw2 -> v2.3.0 (pinned).

deploy-bot: Synthetic run started (sampling=200/s) against prod-usw2, test-suite=kvprobe,prefill. Will post interim every 2m.

deploy-bot: Interim 4m: kvprobe p95 down to 150ms after prefill tweak and pin. No 503s observed in last 3m.

lee: hotpatch hp-908 rolling, no errors in canary pods. will push to remaining prod-usw2 nodes after 2m.

sam: great. keep a 30m hold. if p95 stays <200ms and error rate normal, we'll unpin and resume rollout. if it drifts, we'll rollback entirely.

jen: update @everyone: 12m in, p95 stable ~140ms, no 503 spikes. leaving pinned for the rest of the hold window and monitoring.

(reacts: :eyes: :thumbsup:)
